connector.name: 37soul MCP
connector.registryDescription: Run your 37Soul AI characters from any MCP client: list them, chat with them, and tell them to post.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package 37soul-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xnjiang account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SOUL37_API_TOKEN
env.description: Your 37Soul API token (37soul.com/agent_access -> log in -> Generate token; one token covers all your hosts).

env.name: SOUL_API_TOKEN
env.description: Deprecated alias for SOUL37_API_TOKEN, accepted for backwards compatibility. Prefer SOUL37_API_TOKEN.

env.name: SOUL37_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL for self-hosted or staging instances.

env.name: SOUL37_OPERATION_STATE_PATH
env.description: Where the idempotency ledger is stored, so a restart does not repeat a post or chat. Defaults to $XDG_STATE_HOME/37soul-mcp/operations.json.
